thread:
james_sales: @here quick heads-up — Tidewell (UK fintech) needs SOC2+ISO evidence for our POC. They've asked for: KMS/HSM keyflow diagram, pen-test letter (signed), encryption-at-rest/config details, and the draft SSAE attestation timeline. Can we pull together? Timeline: customer wants artifacts by EOD Fri. :grimacing:

 marta_security: Hi — I can do the KMS diagram and list of controls. Who's owning the HSM keyflow diagram from infra? @ben_infra

 ben_infra: I can export the keyflow diagram. Need to confirm whether customer wants KMS key IDs or general flow. We never share key IDs. We'll provide an architecture diagram + sequence. ETA tomorrow noon. :+1:

 liz_legal: Pen-test letter — legal needs to sign. Is this a standard ops attestation or full scope? Share the POC scope doc.

 james_sales: POC scope attached (link). They only need a pen-test attestation letter confirming periodic third-party pentests + date of last test — not raw report. Also asked for ISO scope (which we host) and SOC2 test period.

 oliver_support: I can pull the SOC2 cover letter and the list of controls we test. We don't redistribute the full report; we can provide a bridge letter and the SOC2 cert snapshot. I'll prep that.

 marta_security: Note: customer asked if keys are customer-managed in Private deployments. Tidewell is planning private later. We should include note: in Private, keys can be in customer's KMS/HSM. For hosted, keys are in our managed KMS (AWS KMS) with BYOK options. Add HSM details.

 ben_infra: Adding the HSM flow: HSM handles root key, we wrap DEKs, etc. I'll include minimal sequence diagram and a short bullet list of cryptographic algorithms and rotation cadence. Any restrictions? @liz_legal

 liz_legal: Keep it high-level. No internal key identifiers. No screenshots of consoles. Legal will sign a standard pen-test attestation with IOUs about sharing redacted report on request under NDA.

 james_sales: Great. Can we also confirm timestamp of last test? I think it was 2025-11-12 but double-check.

 marta_security: Last third-party pentest: 2025-11-12 by Veridian Security. I'll confirm the scope and redact sensitive findings. ETA: today EOD for draft.

 audit_bot: [audit-bot] Automated note: SOC2 cert on file (2024-10-01 to 2025-10-01). Source: vault.redwood.internal/artifacts/soc2-2024.pdf :memo:

 oliver_support: I'll bundle: SOC2 bridge letter, ISO scope statement, pen-test attestation draft, KMS/HSM diagram, and an FAQ about keys. Plan to send to @james_sales for review by tomorrow noon.

 james_sales: Awesome — once we have those, I will route to Tidewell CISO and procurement. Thanks team. :pray:

 ben_infra: Ping me if they need a network topology snippet for Private (VPC peering).

 marta_security: Uploaded draft diagrams to /shared/compliance/tidewell-poc (link). Please review.

 liz_legal: I'll queue the pen-test attestation for signature after the draft. Expect final signed copy within 48h once we have the draft.

 james_sales: Filing this as thread for PRD: I'll attach customer NDA and the list of deliverables. Thanks all. :tada:
